Title: Culture Kitchen
ShortDescription: Our latest and most complete game. Culture Kitchen is a cooking simulator with some tycoon-like elements. Manage ingredients, create dishes, serve customers, and pay your taxes!

Title: The Flesh Pit
ShortDescription: A take on the internet worldbuilding project, “The Mystery Flesh Pit”. This game was intended to be a first person roguelite dungeon crawler, where you would solve puzzles, avoid enemies, collect items, and uncover the larger narrative of the game.

Title: Lasting Leviathan
ShortDescription: Lasting Leviathan was our first successful game jam project. It’s a short fishing tycoon game where the player needs to manage their crew and make enough profit to eventually hunt down the Leviathan. This was a good test of our skills under pressure and time constraints.

Title: Fishy Fishy
ShortDescription: Fishy Fishy was our first real attempt at making a full video game, planned to have multiple locations, a full game loop, and a complete story arc. It was meant to be a fishing tycoon where you would shoot fish, catch them, and sell them for profit

Title: Untitled Horror Game
ShortDescription: Baked Biscuits original game. We started this project to test if we could really make a game. It was intended to be a short horror game where you play as a school janitor after hours. This was not a very well made game, but it showcases our first attempts at making simple game mechanics.
